title: 壁掛け式の小便器
description: 公共トイレの壁面に配置する小便器。開いた受鉢、釉薬調の背板、排水口、センサー風の給水部、背面固定金具と短い排水接続部を造形。壁・水・内部配管や洗浄・検知動作は含みません。取付高さと壁離れはシーンで調整し、衛生や給排水基準への適合は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.406 × 0.875 × 0.472 m、6,448三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A wall-hung urinal for public washrooms, with an open collection bowl, glazed-looking splash back, drain, sensor-like flush fitting, rear mounting rails and short waste connector. Wall, water, internal plumbing, flushing and sensing behavior are absent. Adjust installation height and wall offset in the scene; hygiene and plumbing-standard compliance are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.406 × 0.875 × 0.472 m; 6,448 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
